scripts.build:cloudflare:staging: VITE_PUBLIC_BASE=/fair-measure/ VITE_API_BASE=https://fair-measure-api.fly.dev VITE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false vite-ssg build && node scripts/check-prerender-output.mjs && node scripts/check-cloudflare-output.mjs staging
scripts.build:cloudflare:production: VITE_PUBLIC_BASE=/fair-measure/ VITE_API_BASE=https://fair-measure-api.fly.dev VITE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=true vite-ssg build && node scripts/check-prerender-output.mjs && node scripts/check-cloudflare-output.mjs production
scripts.dry-run:cloudflare:staging: npm run build:cloudflare:staging && npx --no-install wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging
scripts.dry-run:cloudflare:production: npm run build:cloudflare:production && npx --no-install wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:staging: npm run build:cloudflare:staging && npx --no-install wrangler deploy --env staging
